speaker: STEWARD
text: I was just reading a note from the cook downstairs. Apparently I complain too much about the soup.
choices: I’ll let you get back to it.

speaker: STEWARD
text: Too much salt. I asked him to use less. Now he sends notes with my dinner.

speaker: THE COOK’S NOTE
text:
Less salt today.
Try it before you complain.

speaker: STEWARD
text: I’ve known him for years. He’s been teasing me about it all week.
choices: I’d complain about salty soup too.

speaker: STEWARD
text:
You haven’t even tried the soup.

He’d like you.

speaker: STEWARD
text: His bread is good, though. He always saves me the end of the loaf. He knows that’s my favorite part.
choices: You should tell him you like it.
playerReply: You should tell him you like it.

speaker: STEWARD
text: I tell him. But I probably talk about the soup more.

speaker: STEWARD
text: Now I’m hungry. I hope he’s saved me some bread.
aside: He puts the note in the wooden box beside him.
